subject: english
question:
Choose the best one-word substitute for:

"a lover of work"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Ergophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ergophile"** refers to a lover of work; someone who enjoys working or is fond of work. (काम के प्रति प्रेम रखने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** John is an ergophile; he finds immense joy in completing his tasks efficiently and taking on new projects.
 
 
• Hence, the correct word for "a lover of work" is **Ergophile**. (काम का प्रेमी)
 
 
• **Example:** Mary is known for being an ergophile; she dedicates herself to her work with great enthusiasm.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Ergophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sluggard** (आलसी): A lazy or sluggish person.
 
 
• **Example:** He is such a sluggard that he avoids doing any hard work.
 

 
• **Philologist** (भाषाशास्त्री): A person who studies language in written historical sources; a linguist.
 
 
• **Example:** As a philologist, she is deeply interested in the origins of ancient languages.
 

 
• **Egomaniac** (अतिमहत्वाकांक्षी): A person who is obsessively self-centered or self-absorbed.
 
 
• **Example:** His egomaniac behavior alienated him from his friends and colleagues.
 

35:T940,

The correct answer is **Option 2**.
